The unmoderated functions pay the caller nothing: expireQuote(uint256[]) (PartyAFacet.sol L262 - no fee to the caller), settlePartyALiquidation (credits the recorded liquidators, not the caller), forceClosePosition (price penalty goes to the counterparty), settleUpnl/settleUpnlUnified are onlyPartyB.
